column1: # Bosnian (bs) catalog, Latin script, Ijekavian. Same format as zh-hant.tsv:  context <TAB> source <TAB> translation
# (empty context = a plain UI string; `@id` = a command id; `@plural` = "one|few|other" forms).
# Clean-room: every entry is written from the meaning of VectorCraft's English label, in standard
# Bosnian (historija, sačuvaj, tačka, datoteka, postavke); no other application's localisation was
# consulted or copied. Drafted with AI assistance (Claude Code) from the English meaning; not yet
# reviewed by a native speaker. The wording is shared with storytold/craft-i18n
# (locales/bs/vectorcraft.tsv and common.tsv). Vocabulary: radna ploča (artboard), putanja (path),
# sidrena tačka (anchor point), potez (stroke), ispuna (fill), gradijent, uzorci boja (Swatches),
# uzorak (pattern), neprozirnost (opacity), četkica (brush), praćenje slike (Image Trace).
# Product and format names (VectorCraft, OpenType, PDF ...) stay as they are; `{placeholders}`,
# `code` in backticks and a trailing "…" are kept.
